Method of Attack: Information-stealing malware that steals data from infected computers
Targets multiple browsers including Chrome, Brave, Edge, Opera, Firefox
Steals data from cryptocurrency wallets and password managers (1Password, KeePass 2)
Uses DLL sideloading to execute in context of trusted process
Checks for virtualization and monitoring tools and antivirus before infection
Employs byte mapping encryption to evade detection and analysis
Blocks communication on web browsers to hinder C2 infrastructure analysis
Arrives as software cracks, activators, or key generators hiding in benign-appearing software
Impacted Systems: Cryptocurrency wallets: Blockchain, Binance, Kraken, eToro, Coinbase, Gate.io, Kucoin, Armory, Atomic Wallet, Bitcoin, Blockstream Green, Coinomi, Delta, Electrum, Exodus, Guarda, Jaxx Liberty, Ledger Live, Trezor Bridge, Coin98, MetaMask, Enkrypt
Attack Vector: Delivered via software cracks, activators, or key generators disguised as benign software
